name: El Salvador (9 stars, 1865)
description: Nine alternating horizontal stripes of blue and white with a red canton bearing nine white five-pointed stars in three rows of three.
history: The original 'conservative flag' decreed by the Legislative Assembly on 14 February 1865 and approved by President Francisco Dueñas on 28 April 1865, modelled on the flag of the United States with one star for each of the nine departments. Two stars were added within weeks for the new departments of La Unión and Usulután.
